visual_observation: The pale blue internal canopy chord visible in the original cutout implementation is absent in the corrected native temporal crops. The original-source bounded warp keeps the canopy treatment restrained. The fin weather test is independently clear at240 sampled states.
lessons: Use a complete physical silhouette for clean-background cutouts. A polygon cut through solid canopy can reveal a false sky seam even with smooth alpha and small displacement.
For small, dark, distant foliage, a bounded original-source warp with fixed artificial boundaries can preserve material continuity more reliably than a partial cutout reveal.
Protect small protrusions independently when the main hero contour misses them. Test effect-only frames against an independently traced source region, not just the renderer's broad allowed mask.
A local source-palette bound is a useful independent check for foreign-background injection in bounded remap effects; pair it with native temporal viewing.
limits: No continuous playback, full-delivery frame audit or user artistic approval is claimed by this independent source audit. Final encoded delivery validation belongs to the root task.
